tagline: Good Coffee, Good Music, Good People

contact._doc: PLACEHOLDERS for Edwin. Leave null to hide a link; the site never shows an invented address.

browse._doc: trusted_complete: a successful, reconciled API snapshot may end listings it no longer returns. Set true on 2026-10-20 after the first sync returned exactly the same 339 active ids as Edwin's Seller Hub export. item_refresh_hours: reuse a listing's stored getItem payload for up to this many hours while search still shows the same price/title/bids (keeps an hourly sync to a few calls; 0 = fetch every item every sync).

sync._doc: interval_minutes: run the eBay sync every N minutes (admin sidecar). Set it to null to fall back to one sync a day at daily_at_utc. The Instagram import inside the sync runs once per UTC day either way.

featured._doc: Featured = active records priced strictly above min_price (Edwin, 2026-10-20). An editorial featured true/false overrides.
